title: Non-Fungible Tokens
key_points: NFTs are unique digital assets stored on a blockchain.
They represent ownership of items such as art, collectibles, virtual goods, and more.
NFTs have distinct properties and cannot be replaced by another token on a like-for-like basis.
On the XRP Ledger, NFTs can be created using custom fields in an issuance transaction.
limitations: The source only discusses how NFTs work on the XRP Ledger specifically.
It does not cover general blockchain theory or other cryptocurrencies.
asserts: NFTs represent unique digital assets with distinct properties that cannot be replaced by another token.
